readmeHtml:
IPTV

Collection of publicly available IPTV (Internet Protocol television) channels from all over the world.

Table of contents

  • 🚀 How to use?
  • 📺 Playlists
  • 🗓 EPG
  • 🗄 Database
  • 👨‍💻 API
  • 📚 Resources
  • 💬 Discussions
  • ❓ FAQ
  • 🛠 Contribution
  • ⚖ Legal
  • © License

How to use?

Simply paste the link to one of the playlists into any video player that supports live streaming and press Open.

Playlists

The main playlist containing all channels available in the repository can be found at:

https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/index.m3u

Links to other playlists can be found in the PLAYLISTS.md file.

EPG

Electronic Program Guide for most of the channels can be downloaded using utilities published in the iptv-org/epg repository.

Database

All channel data is taken from the iptv-org/database repository. If you find any errors please open a new issue there.

API

The API documentation can be found in the iptv-org/api repository.

Resources

Links to other useful IPTV-related resources can be found in the iptv-org/awesome-iptv repository.

Discussions

If you have a question or idea, welcome to the Discussions.

FAQ

The answers to the most popular questions can be found in the FAQ.md file.

Contribution

Please make sure to read the Contributing Guide before sending an issue or making a pull request.

And thank you to everyone who has already contributed!

Backers

Contributors

Legal

No video files are stored in this repository. The repository simply contains user-submitted links to publicly available video stream URLs, which to the best of our knowledge have been intentionally made publicly by the copyright holders. If any links in these playlists infringe on your rights as a copyright holder, they may be removed by opening an issue. However, note that we have no control over the destination of the link, and just removing the link from the playlist will not remove its contents from the web. Note that linking does not directly infringe copyright because no copy is made on the site providing the link, and thus this is not a valid reason to send a DMCA notice to GitHub. To remove this content from the web, you should contact the web host that's actually hosting the content (not GitHub, nor the maintainers of this repository).

License

aiSummary.oneLiner: A massive, community-maintained collection of publicly available IPTV channels from around the world.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository aggregates thousands of publicly available streaming links for live television channels globally, organized into standard M3U playlists. It serves as a centralized, open-source database that developers and users can easily plug into any compatible IPTV player software. The project includes automated scripts to validate streams, categorize channels by country and category, and generate Electronic Program Guide (EPG) data. By continuously testing and updating the playlists, it provides a reliable source of free, legal live TV content for media center enthusiasts.
keyFeatures: Global Coverage: Aggregates over 10,000 publicly accessible streaming links from nearly every country in the world.
Automated Validation: Employs continuous integration scripts to test channel links and automatically remove dead streams.
Categorized Playlists: Organizes channels into targeted M3U files based on language, country, and specific content categories.
EPG Integration: Provides accompanying XMLTV data to populate electronic program guides within media players.
Open Database: Maintains the raw channel data in a structured format, allowing developers to build custom applications on top.

useCases.title: Media Center Setup
useCases.description: Home theater enthusiasts import the M3U playlists into software like Kodi or VLC to watch global live television for free.

useCases.title: App Development
useCases.description: Developers build custom smart TV applications that consume the repository's raw API to provide users with categorized live streams.

useCases.title: Language Learning
useCases.description: Students use the country-specific playlists to immerse themselves in foreign language broadcasts and improve their listening skills.

useCases.title: Content Monitoring
useCases.description: Researchers analyze the database to track the availability and distribution of public broadcasting streams across different regions.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This project is for cord-cutters, home lab enthusiasts, and developers looking for a reliable, structured source of free live television streams to use in their media players or custom applications.
